answer: The 1–50 patient volume group (healthcare workers who saw 1–50 patients) is the group showing a statistically significant difference (p<0.05) in COVID-19 severity between BCG and placebo: chi-square = 4.330, p = 0.0375 (2×2: severe [subject max AESEV ≥ 3] BCG 9/423 vs Placebo 2/422). No other volume group is significant: 51–100 has a zero cell (0 severe Placebo subjects; chi² not computable) and >100 gives p = 1.000 — and no other group is significant under any sensitivity variant, so 1–50 is the robust answer.
